# Productlane

Productlane is a customer support and feedback system designed for modern companies, built on Linear.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/productlane/.

## Actions

- **Close Productlane Widget**: Close the productlane widget.
- **Disable Productlane Widget**: Disable the productlane widget across the entire page.
- **Enable Productlane Widget**: Enable the productlane widget.
- **Open Productlane Docs Article in Widget**: Open a specific docs article in the productlane widget.
- **Open Productlane Widget**: Generate a javascript snippet that opens the productlane widget.
- **Register Widget Event Listener** (read-only): Register a listener for productlane widget events.
- **Toggle Productlane Widget**: Toggle the productlane widget between open and closed states.
- **Widget off event** (read-only): Remove a previously registered widget event listener.
